_comment: P4-16. Mutation testing for packages/security only: coverage proves the code ran, a killed mutant proves a test would fail if it were wrong. In place, because a sandbox copy of one pnpm workspace package loses its workspace links; nothing else may run against this package while it does.
_plugins: Named by path: under pnpm, Stryker looks for plugins beside its own package, where this one is not linked.
